title: Nourishing Canadian Chinese Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew featuring Chinese cabbage and nuka-pickle, made in a donabe vessel, this dish is kid-friendly and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly with a mustardy flavor.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped Chinese cabbage and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced nuka-pickle, mustard seeds, and vegetable broth to the donabe vessel.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
